title: Zhang Yiming's Internal Statement: ByteDance Model Rejects AI Distillation, Upholds Long-Termism

content_html:
According to reports, recently, Zhang Yiming, the founder of ByteDance, clearly emphasized at an internal meeting that the development of large models must adhere to a long-term approach and delayed gratification, and should avoid using others' model outputs to temporarily boost rankings.

Zhang Yiming stated that even if ByteDance's Seed team is temporarily behind competitors in the field of artificial intelligence, it will absolutely not rely on AI distillation technology to improve its own models. "Distillation" refers to using data from more advanced frontier models to train their own AI models. Previously, AI giant Anthropic accused several companies of distilling its models, but the list of involved companies it published did not include ByteDance's Seed series models.

It is reported that ByteDance has strictly prohibited the distillation of open-source models internally, and has comprehensively strengthened compliance restrictions through technical means such as API detection. Zhang Yiming pointed out that relying on distillation may bring short-term effects, but it would seriously interfere with real long-term technological breakthroughs.

As global large model development enters deeper waters, the innovation of technological sources and the compliance of synthetic data have become the core focus of the industry. ByteDance's firm cut-off of distillation technology not only reflects its strategic determination for independent R&D and fundamental technology construction, but also indicates that the competition in large models is shifting from pursuing short-term performance indicators to long-term value competition focused on cultivating independent innovation capabilities.

content_html_zh:
据报道，近日，字节跳动创始人张一鸣在内部会议上明确强调，大模型的开发必须坚持长期做法和延迟满足，应避免利用别人的模型输出来暂时拉升排名。

张一鸣表示，即使字节跳动的Seed团队在人工智能领域暂时落后于竞争对手，也绝对不会依靠AI蒸馏技术来改进自己的模型。 “蒸馏”是指利用更先进的前沿模型的数据来训练自己的AI模型。 此前，AI巨头Anthropic指责多家公司蒸馏其模型，但其公布的涉案公司名单中并不包括字节跳动的Seed系列模型。

据悉，字节跳动内部严格禁止开源模型的升华，并通过API检测等技术手段全面强化合规限制。 张一鸣指出，依靠蒸馏可能会带来短期效果，但会严重干扰真正长期的技术突破。

随着全球大模型开发进入深水区，技术来源的创新和合成数据的合规性成为行业的核心关注点。 字节跳动坚决斩断蒸馏技术，不仅体现了其自主研发和基础技术建设的战略决心，也预示着大模型的竞争正在从追求短期业绩指标转向注重培育自主创新能力的长期价值竞争。
